accepted: Configure permitted recovery destinations or automatic recovery and an additional recovery allowance relative to pre-shutdown task consumption.
Support token, subscription-quota and API-spending bases for that relative allowance.

compatibility_obligations: The recovery percentage is not a fraction of saved work to retain; 10% is illustrative and 100% is not unlimited.

The relative cap does not widen other limits or authorize a new host or billing route; multiple-failure policy is unselected.

accepted: Support all six software-update modes as distinct configurable behaviors.

research_not_selected: A universal update-mode preset, current-task/everything/lands boundaries, state migration/retention format and exact version support windows.
Guarantees by failure/component/host and behavior when selected restoration cannot succeed within limits.
